claims.statement: An exact isomorphism of the support-conditioned future-cell gravity/frontier plus residual-winning-line incidence fiber induces an isomorphism of the support-local residual-shape poset, its distributive upset lattice, and every legal one-cell owner-true/owner-false principal cofactor neighborhood.

claims.title: Board-fiber isomorphism preserves the abstract ordinary strong-value algebra
claims.statement: Under the board-fiber isomorphism, legal actions, terminals, successor q states, exact strong action/state values, argmax best-move sets, and Upper/Lower threshold boundaries transport exactly by induction on remaining cells.
guards: does not identify past physical histories or proof/certificate provenance

claims.title: Terminal-extended residual cofactors are compositional left adjoints with exact right adjoints
claims.statement: With immediate WIN_NOW adjoined as terminal top, each legal residual cofactor is a total join-preserving map on the finite support-local residual upset lattice and therefore has an exact right adjoint. Fixed legal action-word maps compose exactly; principal images remain principal, killed/bottom, or terminal; induced closures coarsen along extended fixed words.

claims.title: Four nested monotone endpoint fronts exactly carry partial WDL block semantics
claims.statement: The six contiguous partial WDL bounds LL, LD, LW, DD, DW, WW are exactly a pair of isotone three-valued endpoint maps, hence four nested threshold upsets. These four fronts are closed under exact finite alternating block composition with first-win terminals; Bellman UNKNOWN/WIN/DRAW/LOSS refinement is the special case whose first resolution ordinal equals strong distance.

claims.title: Exact ordinary-value Bellman propagation is an antichain-semiring lattice polynomial
claims.statement: Minimal antichains of the favorable q-state lattice represent upward threshold regions. Min-union is idempotent addition; minimized pairwise lattice join is multiplication/intersection. Fixed-path predicate preimages are semiring homomorphisms. Alternating Bellman threshold propagation is therefore a monotone lattice polynomial over this antichain semiring.

claims.title: Antichain-semiring multiplication admits exact local-skyline factorization
claims.statement: The global maximal product family equals the global maxima of the union of per-outer-generator local maximal projection skylines, so dominated products may be absorbed before global materialization without changing the exact boundary.

claims.statement: The independently reconstructed native shape-lattice/adjoint engine reproduced persisted rank-33/rank-32 controls, closed the selected rank-31 root and two rank-30 roots, qualified 128-bit transformed-state widening on controls, and closed the selected rank-29 root through loss12 plus draw13 Upper and its first two Lower products.

claims.title: Root-scale RBA compactness is now a sparse-semiring frontier-width question
claims.statement: No missing ordinary-value Bellman law is currently exposed. The live exact frontier is rank29 support [3,5,2,1,6,6,6], draw13 Lower: current exact boundary 131121 generators times final fixed-action Lower 41133, an implicit 5393996493-pair semiring product.
